text: The Patriots delivered a statement victory in Week 4, toppling the Bills 29-26 at Highmark Stadium in a result that carried real weight for Mike Vrabel's defending AFC champions—and the national conversation has predictably veered into the territory of gleeful overreaction, with talking heads asking whether New England is back in the AFC East title race after last week's struggles. Drake Maye, who'd been mired in an early-season slide, answered emphatically with a clutch game-winning drive and three touchdown passes despite coughing up two turnovers, proving he didn't need to be flawless to get the job done when it mattered most. The Patriots also made history by becoming the first team to win inside Buffalo's new Highmark Stadium, a detail that underscores just how significant this divisional triumph was—and with all six of their questionable players, including Dre'Mont Jones, Craig Woodson, and Eli Raridon, returning to action for the matchup, the roster depth held up when it counted.
